verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Grok Imagine generating images from text prompts, with control over batch size, aspect ratio, resolution and quality, and editing existing images from a prompt with up to five source images. The consumer Grok product also advertises image creation through Grok Imagine. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of image quality, and detailed documentation of editing inside the end-user Grok app (most editing docs cover the API).
